population.note: 447,420 residents on the 191 inhabited administrative islands (2022 census). assumptions.value: The 102 RTL trips are the services recorded for reference day 2026-10-10.
assumptions.note: RTL calibration is incomplete; missing journeys do not prove absence of transport.

assumptions.value: RTL records one time per stop; it is used as both arrival and departure.
Island/stop access is estimated at 4.5 km/h walking with a 1.25 detour factor.
Same-island access beyond 1.5 km is estimated at 25 km/h local transport plus 5 minutes.
Domestic air departures are generated evenly in 06:00-18:00 at max(1, round(weekly/7)) per day; they are not observed schedules.
assumptions.note: Weekly frequency is an estimate each way from the route table; MACL records do not establish schedules.

assumptions.value: Only domestic routes whose status contains 'operating' are included; 31 airport pairs plus 1 aggregate seaplane row excluded.
Seaplane/resort water aerodromes are excluded from the resident accessibility network.
Intervention service categories are taken solely from the diagnostics, specialist and dental evidence tables; they are not inferred from facility tier.
assumptions.note: Resort/guest-only rows and islands that cannot be resolved are excluded from the served facility list and counted in meta.serviceData.

assumptions.value: Airport-island speedboat access is estimated at 25 km/h plus 10 minutes boarding.
Addu, Laamu, Malé-Hulhulé-Hulhumalé link roads are modelled at 40 km/h plus 3 minutes; distances are centroid-derived with a 1.15 detour.
Health and education facilities are island-level locations, not building coordinates or confirmed clinical services.
